name: Commercial Intelligence Pricing Plate™
alternateName: Machine-Readable Retrieval Pricing and Commercial Rights Boundary Plate
headline: Commercial Intelligence Pricing Plate™ — Deterministic x402 Retrieval Pricing for Naturepedia™, Robbie’s Razor™, Grand Compression, and Plate™ Systems
description: A machine-readable pricing and rights-boundary Plate defining deterministic x402 retrieval prices for Naturepedia discovery, active registered Atomic and Enriched Queries, Structured Plates, bounded registries, System Maps, Knowledge Meshes, and full registry snapshots. Retrieval payments remain separate from commercial data reuse and framework implementation rights.

itemListElement.name: Free Discovery and Preview Access
itemListElement.description: Free metadata, endpoint descriptions, previews, health responses, licensing signals, authority pointers, and validation information.

itemListElement.name: Atomic Canonical Query
itemListElement.description: Active x402 tier settled as 0.005 USDC on Base for one narrowly bounded canonical fact, identifier resolution, routing result, or compact canonical answer. Availability is limited to explicitly registered deterministic Atomic Query payloads.

itemListElement.name: Enriched Relationship Query
itemListElement.description: Active x402 tier priced at 0.025 USDC on Base for one bounded relationship-aware response. Availability is limited to explicitly registered, governed, deterministic Enriched Query payloads; the Robbie George Biography Plate Enriched Query is the current registered production route.

additionalProperty.name: route status
additionalProperty.value: active for the registered Biography Enriched Query

itemListElement.name: Structured Plate™ Payload
itemListElement.description: Active x402 tier priced at 0.25 USDC on Base for one registered and validated Structured Plate payload. Payment grants one endpoint-level retrieval only.

additionalProperty.name: route status
additionalProperty.value: active for registered and validated payloads

itemListElement.name: Bounded Registry, Taxonomy Subtree, or System Map
itemListElement.description: Active x402 tier settled as 5.00 USDC on Base for one bounded multi-record registry, taxonomy subtree, identity graph, or System Map retrieval.

itemListElement.name: Full Registry, Knowledge Mesh, or Snapshot
itemListElement.description: Active x402 tier settled as 25.00 USDC on Base for one complete registry snapshot, Knowledge Mesh, expanded registry, or other premium protected relationship resource.

about.name: Atomic Query Production Activation
about.description: The Atomic Query class is active for explicitly registered deterministic payloads. The production Robbie George Biography Plate identifier-resolution route was verified to return HTTP 402 with amount 5000 and gateway tier atomic.

about.name: Atomic Query Fail-Closed Availability Boundary
about.description: Registered and complete Atomic resources may issue a 402 payment challenge. Known but incomplete Atomic resources return 409 without a payment challenge. Unknown Atomic resources return 404 without a payment challenge.

about.name: Enriched Query Production Activation
about.description: The Enriched Query class is active at 0.025 USDC or 25000 USDC atomic units only for explicitly registered governed deterministic payloads. The production Robbie George Biography Plate Enriched Query has been verified to return HTTP 402 with amount 25000 and gateway tier enriched.

usageInfo: An x402 payment grants one endpoint-level retrieval only. It does not grant training, embedding, bulk ingestion, redistribution, resale, synchronization, private-dataset construction, derivative-dataset creation, commercial implementation, or framework-implementation rights.

hasPart.name: Commercial Data Reuse Rights
hasPart.description: Commercial data reuse rights require a separate written agreement and are not conveyed by an x402 endpoint retrieval payment.

hasPart.name: Framework and Strategic Infrastructure Rights
hasPart.description: Robbie’s Razor™, RRIP, Graph Registry™, Plate architecture, and strategic infrastructure implementation rights require a separate enterprise agreement.
